name: The Islander

meta.start: Wu Shen, Kelv Sternhammer  Baltus Fowler, Torm Ragetotem, Sorek

summary: On Fray Island, warriors from across Azeroth face a trial among their peers. Their trainers send proven fighters there for the next step in their training. The island lies off the Merchant Coast, where chief warrior Klannoc Macleod awaits them.

sections.title: A Gathering of Blades
sections.body: Warrior trainers in Alliance and Horde capitals send students who have outgrown basic drills to test themselves against their peers. Combat shows a fighter's progress, not rank or loyalty. So the journey leads beyond civilized sparring yards to a rugged isle in the Great Sea.

sections.title: Fray Island and the Merchant Coast
sections.body: Fray Island lies east of the Merchant Coast, just south of Ratchet in the Barrens. You can swim there across waters that pass over submerged sandbar shallows. Political ties matter little on the island. Fighters gather before Klannoc Macleod, its chief warrior, and await the trial he chooses.

faq.answer: Fray Island is a rocky outcrop off the Barrens' Merchant Coast, south of Ratchet. Warriors from across Azeroth gather there to hone their craft, spar, and face combat trials away from civil authority.
Klannoc Macleod is Fray Island's chief warrior. He assesses those who make the journey and decides whether their spirit and skill merit further guidance along the warrior's path.

faq.q: Why do trainers from both Horde and Alliance send warriors here?
aliases: why do both factions go here
faq.answer: Trainers from both the Horde and Alliance send warriors to test their martial skill in combat. Trainers in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, Thunder Bluff, and Ironforge recognize Fray Island as a proving ground for warriors who can survive its challenges.

faq.q: How do you reach Fray Island from the mainland?
aliases: how to get to fray island
faq.answer: Travel south along the Merchant Coast from Ratchet in the Barrens. From shore, swim east across the sandbar shallows toward Fray Island.

faq.q: What happens after meeting Klannoc Macleod?
faq.answer: After Klannoc Macleod confirms your journey and weighs your resolve, he invites you into The Affray. This gauntlet tests your stamina against waves of challengers.

angles.text: As a warrior, you pass from basic maneuvers toward the full ferocity and tactical versatility of veteran stances.
As a Horde warrior, you travel from Thunder Bluff or Orgrimmar to the Barrens. There, you prove your strength beyond your chieftains' watchful eyes.
As an Alliance warrior, you cross the sea or Kalimdor's wilderness to reach Fray Island. There, you show your martial devotion in a rugged frontier far from human and dwarven strongholds.
